To shine very much.
--2 To be liked.

प्ररोचन a. Exciting or enticing.
[]
--नं
1 Exciting, or stimulating.
--2 Illustration, explanation.
--3
Seduction.
--4 Exhibition (of a
person) for being seen and liked (by
the people); अलोकसामान्यगुणस्तनूजः
प्ररोचनार्थं प्रकटीकृतश्च

(where
Jagaddhara interprets प्ररोचनार्थं by
प्रवृत्तिपाटवार्थं ‘in order to be
thoroughly acquainted with the world’).
--5
Favourable description of that which
is to follow in a play.
--6
Representation of the end as all but
accomplished; see S.

; (प्ररोचना also
in the last two senses).

प्ररुदित p. p. Crying bitterly,
weeping.

To grow, rise, shoot
forth; न पर्वताग्रे नलिनी प्ररोहति
प्ररुह् f. Ved. A shoot, branch.

प्ररूढ p. p.
1 Full-grown,
developed.
--2 Born, sprung, produced;
यस्यायमंगात् कृतिनः प्ररूढः Ś. 7. 19.
--3
Increased.
--4 Gone deep, rooted;
as in प्ररूढमूल.
--5 Grown long; as in
प्ररूढकेश, प्ररूढश्मश्रु.

1 Sprouting, shooting or
growing up, germination; as in
यवांकुरप्ररोहः.
--2 A sprout, shoot (fig.
also); प्लक्षप्ररोह इव सौधतलं बिभेद

.
--4 A shoot of
light; कुर्वंति सामंतशिखामणीनां
प्रभाप्ररोहास्तमयं रजांसि

.
--5 A
new leaf or branch, twig, spray.
--6
An excrescence.

प्रारोहः A shoot, sprout, new
leaf; see प्ररोह.

1 Growing, shooting forth,
germination.
--2 Budding, sprouting.
--3 A twig, sprout, shoot, spray.

प्ररोहिन् a.
1 Shooting up.
--2
Growing, propagated;

प्रारभ् {c1c} A. To begin, commence;
प्रारभ्यते न खलु विघ्नभेयन नीचैः

प्रारब्ध p. p. Begun, commenced.
--ब्धं
1 What is begun, an
undertaking.
--2 Fate, destiny.

प्रारब्धिः f.
1 Beginning,
commencement.
--2 A post to which an
elephant is fastened; or a rope for
fastening him.

1 Beginning,
commencement; प्रारंभेपि त्रियामा तरुणयति निजं
नीलिमानं वनेषु

;
18. 49.
--2 An undertaking, deed,
enterprize; फलानुमेयाः प्रारंभाः संस्काराः
प्राक्तना इव

To ask or pray
for, beg, request; तेन भवंतं प्रार्थयंते
Ś. 2.
--2 To demand in marriage.
--3 To wish or long for, desire,
want; अहो विघ्नवत्यः प्रार्थितार्थसिद्धयः
Ś. 3; स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयंते

.
--4 To look for, search, be in
search of; प्रार्थयध्वं तथा सीतां

.
--5 To attack, seize or fall
upon; असौ अश्वानीकेन यवनानां
प्रार्थितः

; 9. 56.
--6
To petition, file a suit against.

प्रार्थक a. (र्थिका f.) Asking,
begging, requesting, soliciting,
entreating, desiring, wishing &c.
--कः
A suitor, petitioner.

प्रार्थनं --ना
1 A request, entreaty,
prayer, solicitation; ये वर्धते
धनपतिपुरःप्रार्थनादुःखभाजः

.
--2 A
wish, desire; लब्धावकाशा मे प्रार्थना
or न दुरवापेयं खलु प्रार्थन Ś. 1; 2. 1;
उत्सर्पिणी खलु महतां प्रार्थना Ś. 7; 7.
{2}
--3 A suit, petition,
supplication, a love-suit;
कदाचिदस्मत्प्रार्थनामंतःपुरेभ्यः कथयेत् Ś {2} (the object
is expressed by the loc.; as in
शकुंतलायां प्रार्थना).
--Comp.
--भंगः
refusal of a request^1.
--सिद्धिः f.
fulfilment of a desire;
प्रार्थनासिद्धिशंसिनः

प्रार्थनीय pot. p.
1 To be prayed
for or solicited.
--2 To be wished
or desired.
--यं The third or
Dvāpara age.

प्रार्थयितृ^1 m.
1 One who asks for,
a solicitor, beggar.
--2 A suitor,
woeer, lover (of a lady); लभेत वा
प्रार्थंयिता न वा श्रियं Ś. 3. 14;

; एवं प्रार्थयिता विडंब्यते Ś. 2.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.

प्रार्थित p. p.
1 Begged, requested,
asked for, solicited.
--2 Wished,
desired.
--3 Attacked, opposed by
an enemy;

.
--4 Killed,
hurt.
--5 Required, wanted; sought
for;

प्रार्थिन् a.
1 Begging, requesting.
--2 Wishing, desiring; मंदः
कवियशःप्रार्थी गमिष्यामुपहास्यतां
